_mode_ladder.report: Write the dream report ONLY. No proposal files, no edits outside knowledge/dreams/. Zero risk.
_mode_ladder.propose: Report + write proposal files to knowledge/dreams/proposals/ with status:proposed. Nothing is applied; Josh reviews.
_mode_ladder.auto-safe: Report + proposals, PLUS auto-apply ONLY the actions listed in auto_safe_allow. Everything in never_auto still requires approval, always.
_mode_ladder.auto-dev: Report + proposals + auto_safe_allow, PLUS bounded dev fixes: AIRO dev recipe/function edits, dev stop/start/test, wt testcases runs, ledger + Jira status comments. Hard cap 3 fixes/night, one asset at a time, mandatory snapshot→edit→test→trace-verify→ledger order, any failure reverts and downgrades to proposal.

ladder_rules: The dreamer reads this file FIRST and obeys its mode. If the file is missing or invalid, behave as mode=report and say so in the report.

never_auto is a constitutional limit: NO mode, including auto-safe, ever auto-applies skills/hooks/mods/agents/settings/crons/mcp/commands. Those are proposal-only forever unless Josh edits this file.
Upgrading the ladder is a one-line change: python3 ~/.claude/knowledge/scripts/dream-config.py set-mode propose (or auto-safe). Josh does this himself after reviewing a week of reports.
Every auto-applied change must be recorded in the dream report and is rolled back by the nightly harness backup if it goes wrong.
